answer_2.quote: pass rate and pass@1 are used as the evaluation metric for code generation correctness, where pass rate represents the average percentage of private test cases that the generated programs pass across all problems, while pass@1 indicates the percentage of problems in which the generated programs successfully pass all private test cases.
